messages.author: a61de20aba2b7b8e
messages.subject: Error: Permission denied
parts:
Hi INLA group,
I'm trying to run a simple AR-1 example as in 
https://inla.r-inla-download.org/r-inla.org/doc/latent/ar1.pdf on HPC but getting the following error:

sh: 1: /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl.run: Permission denied

*** inla.core.safe:  The inla program failed, but will rerun in case better initial values may help. try=1/1 

sh: 1: /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl.run: Permission denied

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  : 

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

Could you please help me understand the error? 

Thanks,

Chiranjit

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error: Permission denied
parts:
the INLA package is installed in a system directory, and some of the permission
are not correct.

You may install it yourself in a directory you own, and then you should be fine.

On HPC, you may need to run

inla.binary.install()

and install another build depending on the OS on your HPC

Best
H
